review_comment: The code performs pickle deserialization on untrusted cache data, which can lead to arbitrary code execution. The checksum validation occurs after deserialization, not before, leaving the system vulnerable. An attacker who controls the cache file can inject malicious pickle data that will be executed when loaded. Implement input validation or use a safer serialization format before deserializing untrusted data.

The code deserializes untrusted bytecode using marshal.load_bytecode() without validating the content, creating a path for arbitrary code execution. The cache file contents are derived from template sources that may be user-controlled. Add validation of deserialized bytecode content to prevent malicious code execution.
